description: This file contains shell script code for testing Git's pack-refs functionality, including marking, verifying, and updating packed refs, as well as verifying the behavior when refs are updated or deleted.

methods.name: mark_packed_refs
methods.description: Adds an identifying mark to the header line of the packed-refs file.

methods.name: check_packed_refs_marked
methods.description: Checks if the packed-refs file contains the specific mark indicating it has been processed.
